r13_contract.comparisonModel: If scantlings derived from these regulations are less than those required by the classification society for a ship that has not been ice strengthened, the latter shall be used.

test_cases.rationale: Classification-society baseline exceeds the ice-regulation scantling, and the selected design meets the higher society minimum.
Ice-regulation scantling exceeds the society baseline, and the selected design meets the regulation minimum.
Equal regulation and society minima are met exactly.
A design scantling above both applicable minima is compliant.
Selected scantling is below the higher classification-society minimum.
Selected scantling is below the higher ice-regulation minimum.
Comparable scantling quantities use inconsistent source units.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
